verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The CLAYTONI headline is blown up until it runs almost to the canvas edges and sits right on top of the busy illustration clusters, and the illustration strip is cut off flat at its bottom edge while the top third of the canvas is empty. A is slightly worse because CREATIVE AGENCY sits jammed against the cut-off bottom of the illustrations. B leaves the tagline a clear gap below them, which gives a little more breathing room.
